reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it is presented as a cooking advice and entertainment segment in which Matty Matheson answers questions submitted through Twitter. Its content concerns cooking explanations and household food guidance, including filtering and reusing frying oil, rather than requesting money, credentials, or financial participation. Exaggerated or rude humor does not establish a deceptive offer or connected solicitation.
